name: Attuned Arms (Combat)
body:
Benefit(s): Select any number of combat feats that require you to choose a type of weapon (such as Weapon Focus and Weapon Specialization). You are treated as having the selected feats for all the weapons you have crafted that are legal choices for those feats. You are not considered to have those feats with these weapons for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.
